column1: # suspicious_words.tsv: the suspicious words of Jalil, Usman and Fong (2023), Fig. 6, transcribed by hand (58 words; the paper gives no count and does not say
# where the list comes from). The `group` column is MY judgment, not the paper's: it exists because the list mixes real phishing phrases with generic web and
# CMS path words that look like a data-source property (see docs/plan_jalil2023_improvements.md, section 3).
#   phrase  credential / urgency wording (matched as a substring of the decoded, lower-cased text)
#   brand   a brand or brand script name (substring)
#   kit     generic web / CMS path words, matched only as whole tokens (split on non-alphanumerics), because they are short and common
